definition: Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן),  Simeon (so always AV; RV in Luk.2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used;  __1. the son of Jacob (Gen.29:33): Rev.7:7.  __2. An ancestor of our Lord: Luk.3:30  __3. An aged worshipper in the Temple:  Luk.2:25, 34.  __4. One surnamed Niger: Act.13:1.  __5. The apostle Peter: Act.15:14, 2Pe.1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).† (AS)
